description:
Cast Sage of the Falls by paying {4}{U}.
When Sage of the Falls enters, it triggers, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Sage of the Falls triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to draw a card.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Repeat from step 3.
